summary: Wrote a 6-phase, 6.5-hour implementation plan for the merge_targets.mcp mechanism. Phases: deploy-engine mcp branch in shared/extensions/init.lua plus a verify.lua verifier; plenary spec coverage (including repair of a pre-existing RED manifest_spec test found at authoring time); a durable scratch-tree regression harness under core/scripts/tests modelled on test-deploy-orphans.sh; core docs covering the mechanism and its workspace-trust and already-running-session gotchas; the memory extension resolved per the settled Option 1 decision (drop the nonexistent npx package, document Claude Code's native /ide path); and a final full-gate phase. All four stated requirements map to explicit harness assertions, and no phase deploys against this repository.

artifacts.summary: 6-phase plan for the merge_targets.mcp deploy-engine mechanism, its regression harness, documentation, and the settled obsidian-memory resolution.
